open_points.subject: State 4 request-entry rule versus kernel startup
open_points.text: “Every flow enters through `module:surface`, which handles one request at a time … and applies A16 rule 1 … before any operation's own check.” / “The host starts the kernel process … Only then does `module:surface` accept the first request.”
open_points.question: Is `flow:start_and_recover_kernel` exempt from the request size, token, operation-schema and actor checks in the State 4 preamble?
options: Startup is exempt because no request exists yet
Startup must somehow pass the request checks before recovery
open_points.default_guess: Treat startup as exempt and apply A16 request checks only after the entrance opens.

open_points.subject: Equal contract-version submission
open_points.text: “It checks the purpose rule first … then the A02 rule 1 conditions in their order … It computes `contract_version_id` …; an equal version is returned unchanged … — the A02 rule 1 ceiling checks bind only a new version, so an equal one is returned even after a release lowered a ceiling below its bounds.”
open_points.question: When submitted contract content already identifies an existing version, which A02 validity checks run before returning it, and how is equality determined before the text says to compute its identity?
options: Compute identity after the purpose check and return an existing version before all A02 checks
Bypass only current release-ceiling checks for an existing version but rerun the other A02 checks
Run every A02 check first, which can refuse an existing equal version
open_points.default_guess: Compute the identity after the purpose check, return an existing version unchanged, and apply all A02 issuance checks only when the identity is new.

open_points.subject: TrialExecution file-output disclosure class
open_points.text: “`module:functions` stores the value outputs … and records a file output by its facts only (M07), each with the highest class of the case's inputs” / M07: “for a `file` port only its facts — digest, size and media type, no bytes and never a StoredValue”
open_points.question: Does a trial file output persist a disclosure class, and if so, in which record or reference is that class represented?
options: Add disclosure class to the file facts in TrialExecution
Do not persist it; derive the trial execution's class from its inputs
Create another classified record for the trial file output
open_points.default_guess: Do not add a field; derive the class from the trial case inputs whenever needed.

open_points.subject: `bindings.check_installed_instances` startup validation
open_points.text: “for one it also selects an instance for, a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it”
open_points.question: Which A08 rule 5 checks can and must run at startup when this step has no operation name, binding proposal ports or proposed request shape?
options: Check only the service envelope and selected-instance facts needed for header-collision validation
Validate every capability entry in the service record
Select an operation by an unstated rule and apply its operation-specific checks
open_points.default_guess: Check only the service envelope, selected instance and required-header facts needed for the startup collision check.
